user.title: Smart-me Kamstrup HAN
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should reach your meter.

api.title: Cloud authentication
api.description: Choose how to sign in to Smart-me.

api_key.title: Smart-me API key
api_key.description: Generate an API key at https://portalweb.smart-me.com/api/key

api_basic.title: Smart-me account
api_basic.description: Enter the username and password for your Smart-me account.

modbus.title: Local Modbus TCP
modbus.description: Enter the IP address of the HAN module. Reserve it in your router via DHCP, because the module does not support mDNS discovery.

modbus_fallback.title: Modbus port unreachable
modbus_fallback.description: The meter did not answer on port 502. It is often disabled from the factory. Enter an API key and Home Assistant will try to enable Modbus TCP remotely, then connect again.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Smart-me
reauth_confirm.description: Your Smart-me credentials are no longer valid. Enter them again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Smart-me Kamstrup HAN
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for this meter.
